name: scene-vahi
title: Vahi
description: The pile becomes a ledger: loose receipts, invoices, a bill book and a scrawled chit lift one at a time from a teak table, drift over an open account book while their line is written, and settle on a neat stack; then the book closes and its string is wound. Quiet is a hairline plan of the closed book and the stack; playful scatters the pile at a click. The progress attribute sorts exactly that much.

budget.reason: four kinds of paper, the book that closes, a pen, a clip and a string, each painted by hand in ink and in hairline
